body: Designed artifacts are ontological, shaping, and at times limiting, what becomes possible or imaginable. One path toward mitigating such foreclosures is giving people power over how systems are designed and built. Despite decades of scholarship around systems that enable such authorship, these systems are often evaluated on whether or not they are usable, useful, or technically feasible, leaving questions of ontological boundary negotiation, unexamined. We design two open-ended probes that utilize a Wizard of Oz technique to enable the experience of training a personalized machine learning…
summaryZh: 苹果机器学习团队发布研究，探讨了在用户自主编写的个人感知系统中如何协商本体边界。文章指出设计工具有着塑造和限制可能性的作用，通过采用“绿野仙踪”（Wizard of Oz）技术设计开放式探索方案，让用户能够参与和训练个性化的机器学习系统，从而打破传统可用性评估的局限。
